data.name: Dhia
data.gender_notes: Dhia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘dhiya’, meaning ‘gift from God’ or ‘grace from God’. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl, conveying a sense of divine blessing and spiritual connection. The name Dhia carries the meaning “Gift from God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Dhia usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the grace and blessings of Allah, symbolizing the connection between the child and the divine.
data.etymology: Dhia belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift from God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhia total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
